description: Source code implementing functions to retrieve and process information about associated Wi-Fi devices on a Raspberry Pi access point, including functions to get associated device lists, details, and MAC addresses.

methods.name: rpi_adjusting_the_stringsize
methods.description: Adjusts string size from source to destination, removing newline characters.

methods.name: rpi_wifi_get_clients_count
methods.description: Retrieves the count of associated Wi-Fi clients for a given interface and access point index.

methods.name: get_assoc_client_details2
methods.description: Executes a command to get associated client details and processes the output.

methods.name: get_assoc_clients_data
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific associated client, including MAC, RSSI, IP, bytes, rates, and errors.

methods.name: associated_clients_diagnostic_helper
methods.description: Collects a list of associated clients for a given access point and populates data structures.

methods.name: rpi_getApAssociatedDeviceDiagnosticResult
methods.description: Provides a list of devices currently associated with a specified access point.

methods.name: rpi_getApAssociatedDeviceDiagnosticResult3
methods.description: Provides a list of devices with detailed info (version 3) currently associated with a specified access point.

methods.name: rpi_WiFiAPAssociatedDevicesGet
methods.description: Returns MAC addresses of devices associated with a specified access point.

methods.name: rpi_getApAssociatedClientDiagnosticResult
methods.description: Returns detailed info of a specific associated client MAC address for an access point.
